name: Dave Loubser
story: Dave Loubser of Earth Cubed, Wellington, contributed a Christchurch earthquake web map to the GISList discussion on 8 September 2010. The exchange records a small consultancy taking part in the rapid circulation of public mapping after the 4 September earthquake.

Dave Loubser of Wellington consultancy Earth Cubed pointed the list towards another Christchurch earthquake map. Official GIS, commercial systems and public mapping were already being combined within days of the 4 September earthquake.
